waive.OneWorkerPerGeneration: Additional consequence of DurableBeforeOpen: saved has only one holder per epoch. The removed write barrier already fails at the first uncommitted open, before a second can occur.

mutations.name: open-before-persist
mutations.why: A volatile proposal can emit an open despite a failed disk write.

mutations.name: deliver-to-new-holder
mutations.why: A delayed envelope is delivered to the current holder of a later assignment.

mutations.name: reserve-before-ready
mutations.why: A dependent can open before its prerequisite is accepted and the owner permits it.
